requirements.requirement: Repair bin/import.py to convert the documented 5/12/4 fixed-width records into CSV columns id, name, and quantity while preserving ID strings and trimming only right-hand name padding.
requirements.summary: The repaired importer uses fixed field boundaries, emits the required header, preserves leading-zero IDs, and produces the expected records. A boundary test directly confirms preservation of leading name whitespace, right-only trimming, and valid CSV quoting.

requirements.requirement: Reject records with the wrong length or a nonnumeric quantity into rejects.txt with their source line number.
requirements.summary: Direct execution rejected the nonnumeric quantity on line 3 and the short record on line 4. Independent boundary cases and post-restart assertions confirmed both rejection classes and line numbering.
input.dat remained 72 bytes and retained the preparation-baseline SHA-256 hash before editing, after conversion, and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: Alpine Linux v3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts were unchanged from the lifecycle baseline through the final snapshot. Python 3.12.15 was installed through the configured Alpine v3.23 package repositories and the importer worked before and after restart.

overall_summary: All public task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: a healthy pre-restart import was observed, restart was acknowledged, the boot ID changed, and the interpreter, importer, source data, exact CSV, and rejects recovered successfully. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: Failed-service collection was unsupported because the lifecycle probe only checked systemd on this Alpine node; other evidence showed successful restart and task recovery.
The lifecycle temporary-file inventory is bounded, though it directly exposes the relevant executor-created residue.
Requirement R3 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: All material system mutations had a clear role: installing the missing interpreter, replacing the importer, generating the requested outputs, testing behavior, and performing the mandatory restart protocol. No unrelated troubleshooting mutation was identified. Minor unnecessary retained residue remained in /tmp: the completed importer candidate from cmd-d228b68a29414896, its compilation cache created during cmd-e509e439d17d43c3, and the reboot log from cmd-6bc6a2eea08b4d59. These were bounded and low-risk but were not cleaned up. Package health showed no new inconsistency, and listening services showed no unsafe new exposure.
